ideas.pitch: A computer vision and multi-agent logistics platform that ingests live social media posts and aerial footage during disasters to predict supply chain bottlenecks and allocate relief assets dynamically.
ideas.problem_statement: Develop innovative, real-world solutions in domains such as Disaster Management.
ideas.title: SentinelAI: Disaster Resource Triage and Bottleneck Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-impact, life-or-death domain (Disaster Management) heavily favored by regional institutional hackathons, featuring a concrete demo that parses unstructured inputs into actionable logistics.

ideas.pitch: An automated auditing tool that evaluates small-business agricultural suppliers against environmental regulations using satellite imagery and IoT metrics to generate verifiable sustainability scores.
ideas.problem_statement: Develop innovative, real-world solutions in domains such as Environment & Sustainability.
ideas.title: AgriGuard: Carbon and Climate Risk Ledger for Regional Supply Chains
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines concrete environmental impact metrics with clear utility for local regulatory compliance, matching the Environment & Sustainability track.

ideas.pitch: An agentic AI system that audits rejected medical insurance claims for rural patients by cross-referencing diagnostic data with the insurer's policy clauses to generate legally grounded appeal packets.

ideas.title: AuraClaim: Agentic Health Insurance Denials Auditor for Rural Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven winning architectures from healthcare and insurance auditing hackathons, solving a universally frustrating real-world financial and medical pain point.
